cohort: The study participants were pregnant women, with and without Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE), whose pregnancies crossed 20 weeks of gestation, recruited from a tertiary referral center.
finding: Pregnant women with SLE had a significantly higher risk of adverse feto-maternal outcomes, including HDP, SGA, preterm birth, and perinatal loss, compared to those without SLE.
gest_age: Pregnancies beyond 20 weeks of gestation; preterm birth defined as < 37 weeks
